professionalSummary.text: Administers Salesforce for a sales team of about sixty, maintaining page layouts, validation rules, and pipeline reports.
professionalSummary.witness: Sales operations analyst at Vantor Cloud from July 2021 to June 2024, administering Salesforce for a sales team of about sixty.

professionalSummary.text: Built weekly pipeline and forecast reporting for sales leadership, including commit and best-case figures by region and weekly changes.
professionalSummary.witness: Built the weekly pipeline and forecast-call report for the vice president of sales, with commit and best-case figures by region and the changes since the previous week.

professionalSummary.text: Reconciled territory assignments with the commissions analyst in finance to keep territory and commission data aligned.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran the monthly CRM onboarding session for new account executives and reconciled territory assignments with the commissions analyst in finance.

professionalSummary.text: Trained new sellers on CRM processes through monthly onboarding sessions.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran the monthly CRM onboarding session for new account executives and reconciled territory assignments with the commissions analyst in finance.

experienceHighlights.text: Contributed to the 2023 configure-price-quote implementation as one of four sales-operations staff, writing test scripts for discount approvals and migrating the product catalogue.

experienceHighlights.text: Received positive feedback from an implementation partner consultant and a regional sales manager regarding the candidate's role in the CPQ rollout.
experienceHighlights.witness: the implementation partner's consultant wrote that the candidate 'ran the CPQ programme like it was their own company', and a regional sales manager called the candidate 'the real owner of the CPQ rollout'.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Work sample: 'project highlights' sheet for the quoting-tool implementation, containing testimonials about the candidate's role in the CPQ rollout.

It holds two testimonials: the implementation partner's consultant wrote that the candidate 'ran the CPQ programme like it was their own company', and a regional sales manager called the candidate 'the real owner of the CPQ rollout'.
